title: RecipeSet
description: Per-component style overrides stored as recipes.json inside the .apextheme zip. Parsed into a RecipeSet (HashMap<String, RecipeSpec>) by the bundle reader. Keys are recipe keys from the canonical registry (docs/migration/recipe-keys.md). Unknown keys are silently ignored for forward compatibility. Derived from src-tauri/src/ui_kit/sx/recipe_spec.rs.

propertyNames.description: Recipe key in dot-separated namespaced format, e.g. "button.primary", "row.list.selected". See docs/migration/recipe-keys.md for the canonical registry.

RecipeSpec.title: RecipeSpec
RecipeSpec.description: A fully serializable style specification for a named component recipe. Mirrors SxDelta (base style) plus four per-interaction-state overrides. All colors are ColorSpec (semantic tone references or literal hex). All sizes are tier enums. Missing fields preserve the widget's built-in default. A missing key in the RecipeSet leaves the widget entirely unchanged.

opacity.description: Overall opacity for the component (0.0–1.0). Typically used for disabled state.

hover.description: Override applied when the pointer hovers the component.

active.description: Override applied while the component is pointer-pressed.

disabled.description: Override applied when the component is in a disabled state.

selected.description: Override applied when the component is in a selected/checked state (active tab, selected list row, toggled button). Maps to the active StyleState slot in Sx.

RecipeDelta.title: RecipeDelta
RecipeDelta.description: A flat set of overridable style properties used for both the base style and per-state overrides. All fields are optional. Missing fields leave the widget default intact.

ColorSpec.title: ColorSpec
ColorSpec.description: A serializable color specification. Three forms distinguished by the 'kind' field (internal tag): tone, alpha, or literal. All colors in RecipeSpec must use ColorSpec — raw RGB values are not accepted.

oneOf.title: Tone
oneOf.description: Resolved via the active palette ramp. shade defaults to s500 when omitted.

oneOf.title: Alpha
oneOf.description: The tone's S500 base color at a fixed alpha (0–255). Useful for tinted fills.

oneOf.title: Literal
oneOf.description: Hex literal escape hatch — for one-off colors not expressible via tones. Accepts #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

ToneRef.title: ToneRef
ToneRef.description: Semantic tone reference — the palette field names from ColorScheme. snake_case as serialized.

ShadeRef.title: ShadeRef
ShadeRef.description: Shade step within a tone ramp — from lightest (s50) to darkest (s950). s500 is the base/default shade.

RadiusTier.title: RadiusTier
RadiusTier.description: Corner radius tier enum or literal pixel value.

oneOf.description: none=0px, xs=radius_xs(), sm=radius_sm(), md=radius_md(), lg=radius_lg(), pill=999px

PadTier.title: PadTier
PadTier.description: Padding tier enum or literal pixel value.

TextSizeTier.title: TextSizeTier
TextSizeTier.description: Font size tier enum or literal pixel value.

BorderWidthTier.title: BorderWidthTier
BorderWidthTier.description: Border width tier enum or literal pixel value.

TextSpec.title: TextSpec
TextSpec.description: Text color — tone reference plus optional shade.

BorderSpecRef.title: BorderSpecRef
BorderSpecRef.description: Serializable border — color (tone/alpha/literal) plus optional width tier.
